title: arcmap Data Schema
description: Schema for the DATA JSON injected into the arcmap HTML template. All fields beyond the required core are optional — partial or shallow maps are valid.

monorepo.description: Monorepo tool if applicable: nx, turborepo, pnpm, yarn, lerna, bazel, cargo, gradle, go-workspaces

infraComponents.description: External/infrastructure components (databases, queues, observability, SaaS, etc.)

envVars.description: Optional audit of environment variables read by the codebase

projects.description: Array of project IDs in this layer

from.description: Project ID, infraComponent ID, or free-text source name

to.description: Project ID, infraComponent ID, or free-text sink name

protocol.description: e.g. HTTP REST, AMQP, Direct DI, gRPC, WebSocket, File Import, GraphQL, tRPC, SSE, Webhook

id.description: Unique identifier, typically the project folder/namespace/package name

shortName.description: 2–3 word display name for UI labels

type.description: Project role. Common values: api, service, library, worker, scheduler, frontend, mobile, desktop, cli, gateway, bff, test, infra, data, docs. Renderer accepts any string but styles the listed ones specially.

technology.description: Framework + runtime (e.g. C# / .NET 9, Next.js 15 / TypeScript, Django 5 / Python, Rails 7 / Ruby)

language.description: Primary language (C#, TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, Ruby, PHP, Elixir, Swift, Dart)

icon.description: Icon key used by the template renderer. One of: cube, cog, server, refresh, database, globe, clock, mobile, desktop, browser

keyPatterns.description: Up to 5 notable architecture patterns or technologies

entrypoints.description: Known entry-point file paths (e.g. Program.cs, main.go, index.ts, manage.py)

category.description: File role. Common values listed in SKILL.md; the renderer colors the listed set. Arbitrary strings are permitted for extended taxonomies.

endpoints.description: Optional explicit HTTP/RPC endpoints exposed by this file. Populated for Endpoint category files when detectable.

dependencies.description: Names of files, modules, or interfaces this file depends on

usedBy.description: Names of callers / consumers of this file

type.description: Type kind. Common values: class, interface, enum, record, abstract class, sealed class, static class, trait, struct, union, type, module. Arbitrary strings permitted.

signature.description: Full method signature including return type and parameters

method.description: HTTP verb or RPC tag: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, HEAD, SUBSCRIBE, QUERY, MUTATION, ANY

auth.description: Auth requirement if any (e.g. JWT, ApiKey, Public)

to.description: Target project ID or infraComponent ID

type.description: Connection protocol/relationship type. Recognised values with styled edges: http, di, reference, amqp, grpc, websocket, file, graphql, trpc, sse, shared-db, env, webhook. Arbitrary strings permitted but render in neutral grey.

label.description: Short edge label shown on graph and diagram

category.description: Component category for grouping. Common values: messaging, database, cache, observability, storage, auth, gateway, erp, external, queue, search, llm, payments, mail, cdn, serverless, orchestrator.

notes.description: How this component is used by the system

usedBy.description: Project IDs that reference this variable

secret.description: True if the value is sensitive (token, secret, password)
